The '''V5 medium cargo floater''' was a cheap but reliable type of [[Hoversled/Legends|hoversled]] manufactured by [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]. It could be found on many [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].
